note: The twelve contract faults GATE-001..012. Each mutation must be detected by the named gate, and a source/file gate must be GREEN before the mutation (otherwise detection proves nothing): such a mutation is reported NOT VALIDATED, never detected. Source mutations are single-occurrence anchors; the harness reapplies the original text and re-runs the gate. A gate name may carry a case filter: fixtures:error_envelope, cli:RUN-014, corpus:lang/016, cargo-test:<test-name>. An invoke mutation IS the fault (an empty differential corpus); there is no tree to mutate or restore.
